sequence: Use console bootstrap first via local_serial or tcp_console/ser2net.
Enable management SSH only through an explicit guarded bootstrap workflow.

cisco.safety: No configure, write memory, reload, copy, erase, or SSH changes run from this check.

sequence: Use Redfish direct as the default API path.
Use HPE iLOrest when vendor tooling provides better coverage for iLO settings, firmware, or inventory.
Keep all iLO write lanes behind explicit local-lab-readwrite acknowledgements.

sequence: Install ESXi through iLO virtual media and Kickstart readiness gates.

Reserve deployment operations for approved post-install workflows.
esxi_vsphere.safety: This run checks local tools only and does not deploy or reconfigure hosts.

sequence: Use netapp-ontap Python client or ONTAP REST as the primary managed-state path.
Use ONTAP REST direct where simple GET/compare logic is enough.

netapp.safety: NetApp remains preview-only until an explicit read-only discovery lane is added.
